annotations.title: The price on a rig, skill, harness or agent

description: Public. Is this item paid, and what does it cost? Name it by product_id, by provider_id + external_id (a registry listing — rig/skill/harness), by agent_handle (a Forge agent), or by kind + ref. A pack is kind 'pack' + ref = the pack id. Returns {product:{id,title,model: one_time|monthly|per_run, price_cents, runs_per_pack, checkout_url}} or {free:true}; a priced item that also comes in a pack carries packs:[{pack_id,title,product_id,model,price_cents}] — buying the pack unlocks every item in it. A paid item answers any run with 402 purchase_required until you buy it: product_checkout (rail 'x402', 'usdc' or 'sol' for agents — no browser; 'card' for a human).

external_id.description: With provider_id: the listing's id in that provider.

kind.description: With ref: the kind of item.

product_id.description: A product id, when you have one.

provider_id.description: With external_id: the registry listing's provider, e.g. rokha.

ref.description: With kind: the listing id, agent id or pack id.
